'''Morturr Heth''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and a member of the [[Disac pirates|Disac gang]]. After [[Ket Maliss]] destroyed the gang, Heth, one of the few survivors fled, stealing [[Az-Iban]]'s ship and heading for safer space. Assuming Az-Iban's identity, the surviving pirates were captured by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Barse Neomen]] along the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]]. They had attempted to hijack the ''[[Destination: Adventure!]]'' shortly before the Battle of Endor, but their attempts were thwarted.
